rules.source_quote: This facility is applicable for War Bereaved, War Disabled and Attributable Peacetime casualties only.
rules.note: Reviewed by Nidhi Kaushik (Role 1) 2026-11-11. Official source ksb.gov.in confirms the scheme is restricted to these three categories.

rules.source_quote: The applicant must have taken a home loan from a bank, government/public sector undertaking, LIC, GIC, or HUDCO.
rules.note: Cited passage is from myScheme; the official KSB page (BENEFIT-01) confirms the scheme reimburses interest on such loans. Rule is correct. Reviewed 2026-11-11.

unresolved: The Rs 1,00,000 loan limit caps the subsidy; it is a benefit limit, not an eligibility rule.
